events.title: Patch Notes
events.summary: You can now dig from any point along a corridor, letting you carve out mounds and chambers anywhere inside your nest. Shape your colony exactly the way you want!New FeaturesEnemy Health Bars: You can now see enemy health.Hot Spring (Spa): A new healing structure has been added for restoring NPC health. Once repaired, it can be used by all NPCs.ChangesHeal Item Production Removed: Healing items are no longer produced, as the Hot Spring replaces them.Worker Resource Pickup: After finishing a dig,

events.title: Udpate Notes
events.summary: NewAdded range indicators for the Task Banner and the Scarecrow while carrying/placing them.Birds and flying bugs can now steal sticks from saplings.Beetles can now set off traps.Added Discord, YouTube, and recent video links to the main menu.ChangesNPCs now lose health before dying of starvation, instead of dying outright.The Scarecrow now scares all passive NPCs except Thieflings when they enter its area. It also wears out over time and eventually disappears.Carryworm spawn delay and movement

events.title: Update Notes
events.summary: FixesFixed the underground stone resource not being breakable.Fixed being unable to build with iron and gold.Fixed the heal item not working.Surface resources now NOT spawn in front of the video object.Fixed digging and building tasks conflicting with each other.Worker ImprovementsFixed worker animations. Workers no longer play the digging animation while gathering resources; digging is now only used when opening holes.Workers no longer walk to the feed target’s original position. They now track
